name: Filigree
author: Erin Carter
description: A delicate ornamental lattice — a grid of thin glowing rounded-diamond outlines that pulse brighter in slow waves rolling across the field, like etched metal lacework catching light. Cell interiors stay near-black; the outlines trace palette colours by position.

params.label: Wave speed
params.effect: Speed the diagonal brightness wave rolls across the lace, lighting the diamonds in slow bands; 0 holds an even still net.

params.label: Lattice spacing
params.effect: Size of each diamond cell in CSS px - a dense fine ornamental lace at the minimum, an open airy net at the maximum.

params.label: Line weight
params.effect: Thickness of the lace strokes in CSS px - a delicate hairline filigree to a bold engraved lattice.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Brightness of the lace strokes and the node jewels where the diamonds meet; low is a quiet etched net, high a luminous woven mesh.
